DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_ThiefBird:
A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking.
No reason to be concerned when caught in the act.
Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_ThiefBird:
Can be ridden as a flying mount. 

While in party, 
increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Darkness| style=|Effect_Darkness|/> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
